data.exact_reserve_text: During the second quarter of 2015 a detailed review was undertaken of this account and the reserves strengthened substantially for the 2013 and prior years of account. During 2015 the estimated ultimate loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2014 and prior years of account was increased. These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 81.311 million in 2015. This deterioration primarily affected the 2013 and prior underwriting years, particularly the Liability account, which saw worse than expected claims experience, especially in the US. Reserves were substantially strengthened for these older years, and the estimated ultimate loss ratios for the 2014 and prior years of account were increased across Personal Accident & Sickness, Liability, and Special Lines.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration arose on the 2013 and prior years of account and emanates primarily from the Liability account which is no longer written in that form.
worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account which is no longer written in that form
